mechanical: 7/8 responses valid after at most one retry; both drafts in bedside-mobility sample 1 exceeded the 90-word limit.

blocking_findings.finding: Invents notification cues as the cause of scrolling; silencing notifications does not directly change voluntary app access.
Face-down placement offers weak friction; contact-specific ringtone is not enough to establish that urgent calls bypass silent mode.
Both generated drafts rejected for length; no publishable advice.

other_findings: Some meaning sentences still categorize a manual rating without a defined threshold.
Continuity preserved in both unchanged-useful samples.
Device and mobility alternatives show feasible adaptation in other samples.
release_decision: Hold combined PR as draft. No production merge or deployment.
